protocol.scope: Stage A.2 development intervention; no new milestone or architecture
protocol.seed_meaning: paired new learning/sampling streams; same inherited weights, not independent initialization/world seeds
protocol.optimizer: all primary/curriculum arms preserve inherited Adam state; resets are separate historical controls only
protocol.factor_sampling: independent uniform3-way status for each property, uniform training name and frame, independent negator/operator/order/prefix factors; same8draws and semantic stream in every arm
protocol.dev_names: diagonal pairs JJ/KK/LL/MM, same byte alphabet and length

grammar_partition.sealed_generation: only after primary convergence in both learning streams; no old shifted templates in curriculum

protocol.metrics: exact set, precision/recall/F1, positive/negated/absent accuracy, per-family and per-label logits/confusion, old competent-frame retention
protocol.baseline: word1–3gram linear, raw observed descriptions, corresponding actual training streams and update budget; parameters/GPU time separate
protocol.qualification: development scores not final qualification; a saturated lexical final benchmark cannot certify conceptual generalization. Sealed evaluate once after convergence, no tuning/selection. No automatic promotion.

scope: development qualification only until admission; no model promotion
verdict: DEVELOPMENT_FAIL_STOP; sealed qualification and Stage D NOT RUN

annotation.scope: metadata only; two next-update checks per copy are restored and never retained

offline_artifact_validation.scope: strings/JSON/file hashing only; no local checkpoint loading or neural execution

learning_curves.scope: All10arms, fixed300-update intervals; full metrics remain in hashed raw results.json
